standard_prerequisites.name: The subsheaf of sections whose support is contained in a specialization-stable subset, and its description as the filtered colimit of the sections with support in the closed subsets contained in it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on supports of modules and its local description (source line 3325), used together with a lemma of the chapter on dualizing complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the kernel of the required quotient and makes the depth condition a condition on associated primes.

standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the compatibility of the construction with flat morphisms once uniqueness is known.

core_obligations: Reformulate the depth condition: the proof observes that the third condition says exactly that the associated points of the quotient avoid T, so the quotient must be the sheaf theoretic quotient by the subsheaf of sections supported in T, which gives uniqueness immediately (proof lines 3312-3315)
Flat pullback: the statement about flat morphisms follows from the cross-chapter flatness statement together with the uniqueness just proved (proof lines 3315-3317)

Reduce to the affine case: the question is local, so the proof assumes an affine base and a coherent module associated to a finite module, with the quotient by its sections supported in T (proof lines 3320-3325)

Existence and the depth bound: the quotient agrees with the original module away from T, and because the sections supported in T are a filtered colimit over the closed subsets contained in T, a lemma of the chapter on dualizing complexes shows that the quotient has no section supported in T, whence none of its associated primes lies in T and the depth bound follows (proof lines 3326-3333)
proof_roadmap: 条件 (3) 等价于 Ass(F') ∩ T = ∅，故 F → F' 只能是「按支撑含于 T 的截面子层」作商，唯一性立得；平坦拉回由跨章平坦性引理加唯一性得到。
存在性化为仿射情形：令 M' = M / H^0_T(M)，其中 H^0_T(M) = colim_Z H^0_Z(M)（Z 取 T 内闭子集）；由 dualizing 章引理得 H^0_T(M') = 0，即 M' 的关联素都不在 T 中，从而得到深度条件。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement provides the universal quotient of a coherent module whose associated points leave a specialization-stable subset, characterised by surjectivity, isomorphism away from the subset and a depth bound at the points of the subset, together with its compatibility with flat pullback (author lemma at source lines 3294-3309, label lemma-get-depth-1-along-Z). The proof (source lines 3311-3334) translates the depth condition into a statement about associated primes, which identifies the quotient as the quotient by the subsheaf of sections supported in the subset and gives uniqueness at once (proof lines 3312-3315), and then proves existence by reducing to the affine case and using the colimit description of the sections supported in the subset together with a lemma of the chapter on dualizing complexes (proof lines 3320-3333). The identification of the quotient with the quotient by the supported sections is the content; the author marks only the routine locality argument as a small omitted detail. H2.
